assumptions.choice: Logged transactions into an in-memory list attribute `self.db` on order execution.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment restricts imports to standard backtrader/math/collections/statistics modules and does not provide an external database service.

assumptions.choice: Exit open positions via `self.close()` when an exit condition is met before entering new positions.
assumptions.reason: Follows canonical default of using `self.close()` for position exits and holding at most one position at a time without immediate position flipping.

assumptions.choice: Deferred initial capital setup to the harness Cerebro engine ($10,000 starting cash).
assumptions.reason: The strategy class is executed within a fixed harness environment that manages Cerebro instantiation and cash allocation.
